title: Microtiles MVP re-scope and graceful degradation for Console insights
creator: Avery Liu
description:
Context: The initial Console Insights PRD aimed to ship three feature-heavy cards (full route-level cost breakdown, continuous trace explorer, and per-model dashboard). Given time and infra constraints this quarter, we need an explicit, minimal-surface MVP that delivers immediate value to users while preserving upgrade paths for richer functionality. This ticket captures the re-scope to a set of compact 'microtiles' (small insight widgets), the graceful-degradation behaviors when backend traces or cost aggregates are slow, and the acceptance criteria to consider the trimmed MVP done.

Scope decisions made here: (1) Ship 5 microtiles instead of 3 full cards. Microtiles include: total monthly spend sparkline, 7-day latency p50/p95 sparkline, error-rate micro-alert (threshold badge), top-3 routes by token volume (aggregated), and model-variant anomaly indicator (binary flag). (2) Defer route-level cost drilldown and per-request flamecharts to post-MVP. (3) Tracing: deliver sampled trace links with lightweight metadata only; full trace explorer and timeline zooming moved to next release. (4) Cost breakdown: replace the interactive stacked waterfall with a single sparklines-plus-topline card and a 'quick-export' CSV action. (5) Rollbacks/fallbacks: when aggregates exceed latency SLOs, microtiles show cached values with a 'stale' badge and a CTA to open a lightweight 'status modal' that explains delayed metrics and links to the ingestion dashboard.

Why this cut: reduces integration scope for backend aggregation, avoids building a full trace renderer, preserves high-value observability signals (cost trend, latency, error spikes) for customers, and keeps the Console surface responsive under load.

Risks: Possible customer confusion from limited drilldowns — mitigate with clear microcopy and an in-console help panel. Reduced tracing fidelity may limit triage for advanced users — mitigate by exposing a link to raw spans in the short-term.
acceptance_criteria: Five microtiles implemented and visible on Insights landing page for users in beta orgs
Each microtile loads in under 300ms under standard Console load (p50), and falls back to cached value with 'stale' badge if backend aggregate latency > 800ms
Cost sparkline matches aggregated billing dashboard totals within 2% for the previous 7 days
Tracing microtile links open the sampled-trace viewer (lightweight) and surface at least trace_id, sample_rate, duration, and root span name
Export CSV action for cost microtile returns route-level aggregates (coarse bucketed) within 5s for orgs with <100k routes, with pagination for larger orgs
Telemetry: events emitted for microtile impressions, staleness fallback, and 'open trace' clicks (event names: insights.tile.impression, insights.tile.fallback, insights.trace.open)
Design sign-off on microtile visuals and microcopy (UX review completed and Figma link included in artifacts)
Load gating: if system-wide tile render failures reach >5% in an hour, Console must show a single 'Insights degraded' banner with links to status and a diagnostics page
